Treasury, legal, and tax accounting — please report any relevant conditions or concerns you have so I can make an informed authorization decision. As it stands, the proposal doesn't finalize the execution method, tax reserve, or filing timetable, so I'll need those details addressed as well.

In this morning's rolling cash forecast, I confirmed that exactly $4,200,000 is the authorized repurchase amount we can pay while preserving the board-approved operating cash floor. To be clear, this $4,200,000 is the repurchase amount itself — not a total pool from which the tax reserve should be deducted. The excise-tax reserve should be booked separately, on top of this figure. The proposed $5,000,000 would exceed what we can authorize without breaching the operating cash floor by approximately $800,000. I should also note that the updated forecast has not yet been circulated, so you would not have seen this figure in the materials currently in front of you.
